name: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of medical devices. It offers infusion and cardiothoracic surgery products and blood purification products, such as central concentrate delivery systems, disposable biological protein glue dispensers, disposable blood dialyzers, hemodialysis filters, hemodialysis concentrates and powders, continuous blood purification pipelines and accessories, dialysis fluid filters, disposable dialysis indwelling needles, dialysis filtration machines, hemodialysis water production systems, centralized liquid supply systems, disposable hollow fiber dialyzers, hemodialysis extracorporeal circulation tubing,…
